care.summary: Fast tropical leafy green for wet beds, ponds, or large trays; loves heat and constant moisture.
care.water: Keep roots wet/moist at all times; thrives in shallow water culture
care.soil: Rich mud, wet loam, or hydroponic rafts
care.fertilizer: Light nitrogen feed weekly in active cutting beds
care.toxicity: Edible shoots and leaves when cooked; wash thoroughly
tips: Contain in troughs outside native ranges
care.climate_notes: Outdoor tropical/subtropical wet-season crop; may be regulated where invasive.
